description: Texas Medical Board license verification and disciplinary status from TMB open data (data.texas.gov, daily): physicians, PAs, acupuncturists and other TMB licenses. Look up a license number or search by name, city, specialty or type; returns license type, degree, specialties, issue and expiry dates, registration and disciplinary status, board action, practice address and license status. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

disciplined.description: true = only licensees with a current board action

licenseType.description: License type contains, e.g. Physician License, Physician Assistant

specialty.description: Specialty contains (filled mainly for medical radiologic technologist and medical physicist licenses, e.g. THERAPEUTIC RADIOLOGICAL PHYSICS); physician records carry no specialty in this dataset
